data.name: Victarah
data.gender_notes: Victarah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘victor’, meaning conqueror, victorious, or triumphant. In Christianity, this name is often given to a child born into a Christian family, symbolizing the spiritual conquest of faith and the triumph over adversity. The name Victarah carries the meaning “Conquers, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Victarah usually hope their child will grow to embody conquers, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the triumph of faith and the victory of the spirit over adversity.
data.etymology: Victarah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conquers, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Victarah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: ויקטארה
in_hebrew.meaning: ונצחיה אלוהים, נצחון אלוהים, תהילה לאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ויקטארה מורכב מיסודות עבריים ויווניים, ומשמעותו 'ונצחיה אלוהים' או 'נצחון אלוהים'. השם מתקשר לנושאים של נצחון ושבח לאלוהים, ויכול לשמש כתזכורת לחסדו וגבורתו של אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Βικταρά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βικταρά προέρχεται από τις ρίζες της νίκης και του Θεού, συμβολίζοντας τη νίκη που χαρίζεται από τον Θεό. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό μπορεί να αντιπροσωπεύει τη νίκη της πίστης και τη δύναμη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Victarah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Victarah derivatur ex radicibus Latinis victoria et Deus, significans 'victoria Dei' vel 'triumphus Dei'. Hoc nomen potest esse recordatio potentiae et misericordiae Dei in traditione Christiana.
